newsitem.title: USA: USDA offers Ukraine $35 Mln in GSM-102 credits.
newsitem.headline: USDA offers Ukraine $35 Mln in GSM-102 credits.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department said Tuesday it was offering $35 million to Ukraine to aid sale of U.S. grains, oilseeds, protein meal, vegetable oils and other ag products in fiscal 1997.
The fiscal year ends September 30. The short-term GSM-102 export credit guarantees will be available on a first-come, first-served basis.
Coverage was offered on:
--cotton.
--wheat, flour and semolina.
--feed grains including barley, malting barley, white corn, yellow corn, sorghum and oats.
--oilseeds including soybeans, sunflower, cotton and peanuts.
--fresh, chilled, frozen, canned, salted and dried fish and shellfish.
--vegetable oil including soybean, cottonseed, sunflower, corn and peanut.
--animal feed products including protein supplements of animal or vegetable origin, compound feed, animal milk replacer and calf starter pre-mix.
--fresh vegetables including asparagus, beans, broccoli, carrots, cauliflower, celery, corn, garlic, lettuce, onions, peppers, potatoes and tomatoes.
--frozen vegetables including beans, broccoli, carrots, corn, spinach, onions, peppers, mushrooms, zucchini and combinations of those.
--canned vegetables including asparagus, beans, carrots, corn, peas, tomatoes and tomato paste.

--fresh fruit including apples, apricots, avocadoes, blueberries, cherries, grapes, grapefruit, kiwi, lemons, melons, nectarines, oranges, pears, plums, peaches, raspberries, strawberries and tangerines.
--frozen orange juice concentrate.
--protein meal including soybean, sunflower, cottonseed, corn gluten, meat and bone, feather, fish and blood meals.
--wool and mohair.

--dairy products including butter, butter oil, ghee, anhydrous milk fat, nonfat and whole milk powder, whey powder, whey protein concentrate, lactose, nonsweetened condensed milk, fluid milk and cheese.
--poultry breeder stock including baby chicks, turkey poults and hatching eggs.
--planting seeds.
--rice.
